name: pcu
units: Cartesian lengths in units of mean parent strut length; E_s=1; no Angstrom conversion
geometry_note: Edges are the two finite elements per parent strut; virtual midpoint nodes are retained. Edge image shifts multiply rows of cell.
displacement_note: displacements are total normalized translations and rotations at stored positions. For an image endpoint add image_shift @ cell @ macro_strain.T to its translations; rotations repeat. periodic_displacements excludes macro strain.
normalization: max node translational Euclidean norm = 1; same multiplier applied to translations, rotations and macro_strain
energy_note: Positive elastic quadratic energy u_e^T K_e u_e, split equally between each element endpoints; normalized to sum=1. Not the zero net tangent energy at onset.

rank_one_diagnostics.interpretation: Cell-gradient fit is descriptive; finite spherical confinement adds transverse gradients and need not give a pure rank-one field.

mode_selection: K-orthogonal projection of localized acoustic shear template into degenerate first eigenspace
